title: Dhisaha Badbaadinta ee Adkeysiga leh
intro: Sharaf aad u weyn iyo kalsooni aan kala go 'lahayn, shaqsigan wuxuu sannado badan u huray hawlgal rabbaani ah, isagoo wajahaya quudhsi iyo diidmo aan kala go' lahayn. Sheekadoodu waa markhaati xooggan oo ku saabsan iimaanka marka la eego gaalnimada xad dhaafka ah, taasoo ku dhammaatay dhacdo muhiim ah oo dib u habaysay adduunka.
clues: Waxaan u huray muddo aad u dheer oo noloshayda ah anigoo dadkayga ugu yeeraya cibaadada Alle.
Dadkaygu way igu jeesjeeseen waxayna igu eedeeyeen qalad cad iyo waalli.
Waxaa la i amray inaan dhiso wax aan caadi ahayn oo u muuqday bulshadayda aan lahayn dhul.
Dad yar ayaa rumaystay oo aniga iyo qoyskayga ku soo biiray dhismahan gaarka ah.
Waxaan doonta ku siday lammaane noole kasta, sida uu Alle faray.
Daad weyn ayaa dhulka qabsaday, isagoo badbaadiyay oo keliya kuwii ila joogay markabkayga, halka wiilkaygiina uu u dhintay gaalnimadiisii ​​awgeed.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
